title: Fuzzer: `FramebufferCacheRD.get_cache_multipass` crashes Godot
body:

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable8 = ClassDB.instantiate("FramebufferCacheRD")
	temp_variable8.get_cache_multipass(Array([Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), 70]), Array([Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), 86, Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), 66, Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), Array([]), 1, Array([])]), 36)

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
